properties.description:
`Decision.quality_target` (the nine axes of DimensionAssessment.dimension, no default), the `set_quality_target` tool that writes it while preserving every other property, and the `quality_target_unstated` gap that reports its absence.

THREE STATES, NOT TWO. An ACCEPTED Decision carrying a target settles the question and the finding goes quiet. A PROPOSED one carrying a target is somebody LEANING — weighed but not committed — and the finding reads "still being weighed" at severity 0.40 instead of "unstated" at 0.55. Nothing at all means nobody was asked. Superseded and rejected targets are history, not a position.

The finding names `set_quality_target` as the answer and names `acknowledge_gap` as the WRONG move, because the gap is aggregate-keyed and accepting it once would silence a deferral permanently.

Gated on the design having said what it DOES: silent at 0 capabilities and 0 requirements, which is `design_without_intent`'s ground.
properties.name: Record what a design is built for, and report when nothing says
